import os, sys, torch, torch.distributed as dist, torch.multiprocessing as mp
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
from parallel_linear import *
def run(rank, ws, port):
    os.environ.update(MASTER_ADDR="127.0.0.1", MASTER_PORT=str(port))
    dist.init_process_group("gloo", rank=rank, world_size=ws)
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    W = torch.randn(8, 16); x = torch.randn(3, 16, requires_grad=True)
    for cls in (ColumnParallelLinear, RowParallelLinear):
        ref = torch.nn.Linear(16, 8); ref.weight.data.copy_(W); ref.bias.data.zero_()
        m = cls(16, 8, True, W)
        xi = x.detach().clone().requires_grad_(); xr = x.detach().clone().requires_grad_()
        y = m(xi); yr = ref(xr)
        assert torch.allclose(y, yr, atol=1e-5)
        y.sum().backward(); yr.sum().backward()
        if cls is ColumnParallelLinear:
            n=8//ws; gw = ref.weight.grad[rank*n:(rank+1)*n]; gb = ref.bias.grad[rank*n:(rank+1)*n]
        else:
            n=16//ws; gw = ref.weight.grad[:, rank*n:(rank+1)*n]; gb = ref.bias.grad
        assert torch.allclose(m.weight.grad, gw, atol=1e-5)
        assert torch.allclose(m.bias.grad, gb, atol=1e-5)
        assert torch.allclose(xi.grad, xr.grad, atol=1e-5)
    if rank==0: print("ok", ws)
    dist.destroy_process_group()
if __name__=="__main__":
    for i,ws in enumerate([1,2,4]): mp.spawn(run, args=(ws, 29600+i), nprocs=ws)
